name: hetrixtools
footnotes: This box has no cron, so the vendor installer's own systemd path runs: a minutely timer starting a transient unit per run. Those runs are placed in a persistent slice (one word added to the vendor launcher) so the kernel's accounting for them survives each run; the timer's launcher unit is counted too.

Memory (PSS, RSS), process and thread counts are missing for this row: the agent's minutely runs live in per-run child cgroups of the slice, and the sampler reads processes from the matched cgroup only, so it saw none. The cgroup's own hierarchical figures are right: memory.current idle median 3.8 MB (p95 4.2 MB), cgroup peak about 14 MB; CPU, disk and network are hierarchical and unaffected.
